description: The whole market in one readable page. Opens with CoinGraph's own record from the last 24 hours (what followed each check), then the market regime (risk-on or risk-off, breadth, leverage, Fear & Greed), what changed ranked by importance, stablecoin and exchange flows, the most crowded futures markets, top movers and headlines — and, if you pass your holdings, a line on each. Returned as Markdown and JSON. Returns one of: RISK_ON / RISK_OFF / NEUTRAL, with a plain summary, structured result, sourced reasons and a proof id. Price: 5 tADA on testnet (premium).
